subject: humanities
passage: Madhubani painting is a folk art from the Mithila region of Bihar, India, known for its bright colors and bold outlines. Art conservator Neha Jha has noticed that the colors in some older Madhubani paintings have faded badly, while the colors in others of the same age still look fresh. She hypothesizes that exposure to sunlight is the main cause of the fading.
stem: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Jha's hypothesis?

choices.A: Many Madhubani artists learned to paint from older relatives in their own villages.
choices.B: Some paintings kept in dim rooms faded just as much as paintings that hung in bright sunlight.
choices.C: Old paintings kept in dark storerooms stayed bright, while those near sunny windows faded.
choices.D: Madhubani paintings were first made on the walls of homes and later on paper and cloth.

explanation.why: Jha thinks sunlight is the main cause of fading. If paintings of the same age faded when they were near sunlight but stayed bright when kept in the dark, sunlight is the difference that matters.
explanation.A: Incorrect. How artists learned to paint has nothing to do with why the colors fade.
explanation.B: Incorrect. If paintings faded just as much without sunlight, sunlight would not be the main cause; this weakens the hypothesis.
explanation.C: Correct. The only paintings that faded were the ones exposed to sunlight, which is what Jha predicts.
explanation.D: Incorrect. What the paintings were made on does not show whether sunlight causes fading.
